facts.scope_summary: Assess the current ChatPro platform and deliver recommendations, services, and implementation support for ChatPro Phase 3, extending the existing production procurement intelligence platform for direct and indirect procurement. Scope includes data readiness, new forecasting and should-cost capabilities, supplier and risk intelligence, AI-driven decision support, and business-friendly Excel/PowerPoint outputs with traceability and confidence.

assumptions: The existing Azure and Databricks landscape is available and reused without architectural change
Mosaic AI capabilities — Agent Framework, Model Serving, Foundation Model APIs, Vector Search, Genie — are enabled with capacity for the projected workload
Environments and CI/CD are extendable to agent, prompt, semantic and evaluation artifacts
Platform capacity and cost for additional compute, serving and storage is provisioned by the client
Access is available to ERP purchase order, invoice, contract, material master, BoM and routing data
The demand forecast is a consumable feed at a defined grain, horizon and cadence, with history to assess accuracy
The price forecast is consumable, or index series are licensed such that a forward price can be modeled
Internal cost model logic, conversion and yield assumptions, and the PPG hierarchy are available
Required external subscriptions are held or procured, with license terms permitting the intended use
A client product owner with authority to prioritize and sign off is available
Subject matter experts are available at an agreed cadence
AD groups and role definitions are agreed with security; Unity Catalog entitlements configured
Security, architecture and governance review points are scheduled in advance, off the critical path
Source access and non-production environments are available by end of week 2
Three Category Managers are available at roughly four hours a week each during weeks 3 to 20
Security and architecture review slots are pre-booked at weeks 5, 8 and 19
At every gate, decisions are returned within three business days
Scope is frozen at the week-5 gate; later changes go to a post-go-live backlog
Source-of-truth hierarchy is confirmed and delivered by PPG's ChatPro team before build begins
Data completeness gaps identified in the Data Quality Assessment are addressed by PPG before go-live
Early CARB engagement and approval occurs for any component outside PPG's approved stack
